name: qfd_c_ringx514

pin_regs.reason: region-crossing tile (owner 10-20 09:05: pin registers only at region crossings, i.e. here): every data input pin i lands directly in the 4 bank slot registers (enable = registered one-hot); output o = the reader's slot SELECT (bank regs on ck_w AND one-hot/warm regs on ck_r -> 2-3 gates -> pin) whose register is the closed station qfd_c_stn<W> on ck_r that the CB16 parent places at the destination (= qfd_c_land_r1k's output register); rsi_w / rsi_r land in the halves' kept reset copies (19 loads). No in->out combinational path.

reset_landing.reason: rsi_w / rsi_r are the region-calendar ring resets; each half re-registers them (rq + one kept copy per 30-bit super-group) on its own clock; the parent delivers them from each region's own equal-depth reset tree

structural_change: QW-CB16REG 10-20 main line (a): every CB16 region crossing becomes ONE hard tile (writer ring qfd_c_land_w1k on ck_w + the reader's slot select on ck_r, W=514, D 4, K 2) + ONE closed station qfd_c_stn514 on ck_r (the reader's output register) at the destination; 69 crossings, 2 tile masters.  Why: the flat soft rings gave each region root 6.7k-20.9k ring flops over 1-2 mm -> within-region TT spread 410-813 ps, WNS -1.4..-1.7 ns after 10-16 h (fulln/fullnb/fullm).  A first single-tile form (writer+reader+output register in one tile, r0 gate 10-20 WARN, spread 12 ps) could not be placed: its one tile must bridge source -> destination (CP-SAT: infeasible below ~600 um reach), so the split moved to the reader's output register: three <=400-um legs as the soft plan.  0 added cycles.

job.purpose: CB16 hardened landing ring crossing tile W=514 (x57 in the CB16 parent)
